title: Verify the evidence on the spot.
next_chapter_hook: Just as the informant collapsed soft, violent spiritual energy fluctuations suddenly came from outside the council hall—the aura was so powerful, it far exceeded anyone present. Deep within the sect, a greater enemy was approaching.

text.content: The atmosphere in the council hall was heavy as lead, all gazes drawn to that purple light descending from the heavens. The emissary from the Holy Sect of the Demonic Path walked slowly across the void, the demonic energy surrounding them causing the spirit lamps in the hall to dim. However, just as everyone held their breath, the Fifth Elder who had been presiding over the matter had no choice but to press on—the evidence verification ceremony had already begun, and stopping midway would be a desecration of sect rules.

dialogue.content: "The honored guests have traveled far, please rest on the high platform." Old Sect Master Ling Yuan's expression remained unchanged as he gestured for the golden-robed disciples standing nearby to guide the Demonic Path emissary to a seat. "The old one still has urgent matters to attend to within the sect. Please wait a moment." His voice was neither humble nor overbearing, yet faintly carried an indisputable authority.

text.content: The purple-robed emissary's lips curved into an amused arc, refusing to sit. Instead, she stood with hands clasped behind her at the side of the hall, her deep eyes scanning Chen Ji, who was being held in the center of the hall. "No matter, this seat has come precisely for this case—I hear Tianqing Sect intends to execute a traitor who colluded with the Demonic Path. Let me see, who is this audacious person who dares to act under our Holy Sect's name?" This speech seemed to distance herself from the matter, yet hidden within was a needle, causing the Fifth Elder's temples to bead with sweat.

dialogue.content: "Fifth Elder, since the envoys from the three sects and the honored guests are all present, please present the so-called evidence." Ling Yuan's voice was unhurried. "Today, let us verify the truth before all the assembled guests, so that certain ill-intentioned individuals may die with certainty." His gaze fleetingly swept over Chen Ji, the chill in that instant vanishing as quickly as it appeared.

text.content: The Fifth Elder took a deep breath, drawing a yellowed letter and a spiritual jade slip from his sleeve, raising them high: "These are the items submitted by the informant—a letter detailing Chen Ji's secret dealings with the Demonic Path; a jade slip containing evidence of Chen Ji secretly hoarding forbidden spiritual formations. Witness and physical evidence are both present, please review, honored elders!" He spoke extremely quickly, as if afraid of complications.

Chen Ji knelt in the center of the hall, his back hunched, his expression panicked—a perfect picture of a startled bird. However, the instant the Fifth Elder unfolded the letter, a faint gleam flashed through those downcast eyes. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly within his soul, seeming to convey some kind of message—the spiritual residue on that paper was completely different from Chen Ji's own spiritual fluctuations that it had recorded.

dialogue.content: "Hmph, this waste always acts more cowardly than anyone, yet privately knows how to make excuses." Han Lie stood at the hall's side, arms crossed, a mocking smile on his lips. "Elders, please examine carefully. Don't let one rat spoil a whole pot of soup. The face of Xuanwu Sect cannot be tarnished by such a person!" He spoke righteously, yet anticipation flickered in his eyes—he looked forward to Chen Ji being convicted on the spot, forever unable to rise again.

text.content: The Fifth Elder was about to hand the letter to the Elder seats and begin reading its contents when Chen Ji suddenly let out a weak cough. "Cough... Honored elders above, this disciple has something unclear, dares to ask—in this letter claimed to be written by this disciple, may I ask the elders... to let me personally examine the handwriting?" He spoke小心翼翼ly, as if afraid to offend anyone.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan narrowed his eyes, his gaze scanning between Chen Ji and the Fifth Elder. After a moment, he said calmly: "Granted." This single word landed, yet the Fifth Elder's expression paled several shades. He forced himself to remain composed, handing the letter to Chen Ji. "Examine carefully. Do not speak drivel."

text.content: Chen Ji extended those calloused hands, accepting the letter. He hunched closer to examine it closely, his fingertips brushing across the paper's surface, movements slow and clumsy. Yet deep within his soul, the Tianji Record Fragment was operating furiously—the spiritual residue on that paper clearly told him: the writer's spiritual attribute differed from Chen Ji's own by at least three levels. This was definitely not written by him.

choice.prompt: Chen Ji sees through the forgery, now must choose how to expose the truth.

choices.text: Expose it directly on the spot.
choices.description: Publicly point out the forged evidence, leaving no room for mercy.
choices.visible_reward: The informant loses face completely on the spot.
choices.risk_hint: May alert the mastermind behind the scenes.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, and a gleam flashed through those murky eyes. He gently folded the letter, his voice neither loud nor soft, yet clearly carrying through the entire hall: "Reporting to the elders, this letter... was not written by this disciple."

choices.text: Draw out the snake before striking.
choices.description: First appear weak to draw out more flaws, then expose everything at once.
choices.visible_reward: Expose the mastermind along with them.
choices.risk_hint: The process is longer, requiring acting skills.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji deliberately showed a cowardly expression, returning the letter with trembling hands: "Elders, this disciple begs forgiveness, I... I truly do not remember writing this letter. Only, this handwriting seems rather similar to someone's..." He hesitated, his gaze inadvertently glancing toward the Fifth Elder.

choices.text: Use the Demonic Path emissary's power.
choices.description: Leverage the presence of the Demonic Path emissary to introduce third-party verification.
choices.visible_reward: The emissary takes the initiative to expose it.
choices.risk_hint: May expose the relationship with the Demonic Path.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly bowed deeply toward the purple-robed emissary at the hall's side: "This disciple boldly ventures to ask—your excellency has traveled from afar, surely must be skilled in spiritual energy verification. This disciple stakes his life on it, this letter was definitely not written by this disciple's hand. Would your excellency be willing to enlighten us?" His manner was supremely humble.

text.content: The hall fell silent in an instant. A muscle on the Fifth Elder's face twitched slightly, yet he forced himself to remain composed: "Ridiculous! You, an Outer Disciple/Servant, dare to question the informant's sincerity? This letter was delivered to the Elder Hall by designated personnel, the seal was intact. Where is the forgery?" His voice rose several notches, his bluster fully exposed.

Yet Chen Ji remained unhurried, unfolding the letter and pointing to one of the ink marks with his fingertip: "Elders, please examine. This disciple, since childhood poor, learned to write using ordinary pine soot ink. Therefore, when writing, the habit was to simplify the character 'de' as a dot and a horizontal stroke..." He paused, surveying the surroundings. "But on this letter, the character 'de' is written in the standard official script style, with meticulous strokes. May I ask the elders—if this disciple possessed such calligraphic skill, why would he spend ten years as a servant in the sect?"

dialogue.content: Han Lie frowned, coldly snorting: "Insignificant tricks! Handwriting can be imitated, what kind of evidence is this?" He strode forward, leaning over Chen Ji. "You waste, could you be panicking and falsely accusing others?"

choice.prompt: Han Lie questions the insufficiency of evidence; Chen Ji needs further proof.

choices.text: Use spiritual energy recognition as proof.
choices.description: Use the spiritual energy difference sensed by the Tianji Record as ironclad evidence.
choices.visible_cost: Consume a small amount of Heavenly Fate.
choices.risk_hint: May risk exposing the Tianji Record.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji raised his head, directly facing Han Lie's contemptuous gaze. His voice suddenly became unusually calm: "Han Senior Brother is right, handwriting can be imitated... but what about spiritual aura?" He slowly stood up, for the first time straightening his spine before everyone. "The writer's spiritual attribute is completely different from this disciple's own—this is a fact no disguise can conceal."

choices.description: Have the three previously arranged Outer Disciples come forward to testify.
choices.visible_reward: Witnesses and physical evidence form a complete chain of evidence.
choices.risk_hint: Witnesses may be bribed or threatened.

dialogue.content: Chen Ji suddenly called loudly toward the hall entrance: "Since Han Senior Brother demands ironclad evidence, this disciple calls witnesses—the three Outer Disciple junior brothers who were on duty with this disciple at the scripture library that day. They personally saw that this disciple never left for a moment, let alone met anyone to hand over a letter!"

text.content: Ling Yuan's gaze suddenly sharpened. The wily old man immediately realized the gravity of the situation—if Chen Ji's words were true, then today's matter would not merely be framing a servant disciple, but rather someone deliberately staging a fraud right under the Elder Hall's nose. He said deeply: "Summon—the three witnesses to the hall!"

A moment later, three trembling Outer Disciples were brought into the hall. The leading Zhou-surname youth knelt and bowed, his forehead pressed against the cold stone, yet his voice was exceptionally clear: "Disciple Zhou Changsheng, that day I was on duty at the scripture library with Senior Brother Chen. From morning till dusk, Senior Brother Chen never left for a single step! This disciple stakes his life on it. If there is any falsehood, may thunder strike me!"

dialogue.content: The other two disciples also kept kowtowing, confirming Zhou Changsheng's words were true. The Fifth Elder's face had already turned as white as paper, large beads of sweat dripping from his forehead. He猛地 turned to glare toward the informant's direction, only to find that person already ashen-faced, legs weak, barely able to stand.

text.content: Chen Ji still maintained that cowardly posture, slowly turning toward the informant, asking softly: "Senior Brother, you reported that I colluded with the Demonic Path. May I ask when, where, and by what means you contacted me? If such a thing truly happened, why have the three junior brothers never seen any suspicious person?" His voice was calm to the point of gentleness, yet every word was like a blade.

dialogue.content: The informant's lips trembled, unable to utter a single word for a long while. Han Lie's expression also became extremely ugly. He never expected that this waste he had never looked down upon would have the ability to turn a certain victory into this模样.

text.content: Chen Ji turned once more to the Fifth Elder, his body hunched: "Elder, this disciple dares to ask another question—the day this report letter was delivered, you happened to be patrolling near the scripture library. I wonder if that was coincidence, or... something else?" His manner was supremely humble, yet what he implied made the Fifth Elder feel as if he had fallen into an icy abyss.

dialogue.content: The Fifth Elder shuddered throughout, lips quivering yet producing no sound. Ling Yuan's gaze fell upon him like a blade, his voice cold without a trace of warmth: "Fifth Elder, this seat is asking you. Regarding this report, how much do you actually know?"

choice.prompt: The truth is about to be revealed; the Fifth Elder is driven into a corner.

choices.description: Point out that the Fifth Elder is the mastermind behind the scenes.

text.content: Chen Ji suddenly raised his head, for the first time directly facing the Fifth Elder. His voice remained steady: "This disciple does not dare to speculate rashly, only recalling one matter—the day the report letter was delivered, the Elder happened to be patrolling near the scripture library. I wonder if that was coincidence, or... something else?"

choices.description: Do not expose directly, giving the Fifth Elder a way out.
choices.visible_cost: Cannot pursue the mastermind behind the scenes.

text.content: Chen Ji withdrew his gaze, lowering his head again. His voice returned to its previous cowardice: "This disciple dares not speak further. Everything shall be decided by the Elder Hall." With that, he slowly retreated to his original position and knelt down, as if those brilliant analyses had never come from his mouth.

A deathly silence filled the hall. The Fifth Elder's face was ashen, his lips trembling as he tried to defend himself, yet not a single word could emerge. The informant had collapsed to the ground, trembling all over like a sieve. Ling Yuan's gaze swept over both of them like an eagle's, the coldness in his eyes making everyone present shiver.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan's voice descended from the high platform, carrying not a trace of emotion: "Guards, take the informant and related persons into custody for detailed interrogation. As for the Fifth Elder—" he paused, "this matter has too many suspicious points, you cannot escape responsibility. For now, relinquish your Elder position and await disposition."

text.content: The Fifth Elder was struck like thunder, his entire body going limp. He was dragged out of the hall by two law enforcement disciples. Before passing through the door, he glanced back at Chen Ji, that gaze full of venom nearly transforming into substance—yet Chen Ji still had his eyes lowered and expression compliant, as if seeing nothing. Only he himself knew: this debt, he had recorded.

The Demonic Path emissary at the hall's side let out a low laugh, that laughter cold and playful: "Interesting. Tianqing Sect's 'waste' has truly opened my eyes." Her gaze fell upon Chen Ji, those deep purple eyes flickering with a meaningful light—much like looking at a chess piece about to mature.

Chen Ji knelt in the hall, his back still hunched, his expression still cowardly. Yet at this moment, no one in the hall dared despise this servant disciple who had been mocked for ten years. The three Outer Disciples gazed at him with admiration, Han Lie's expression was livid, Ling Yuan's gaze was deep as an abyss—and those who had bullied him all unconsciously stepped back half a pace.

dialogue.content: Ling Yuan suddenly spoke, his voice carrying not a trace of emotion: "Chen Ji, though you have cleared yourself of suspicion, the speed of this matter's exposure and the depth of its connections exceed all expectations." His gaze was deep as an ancient well. "This seat gives you three days to investigate and find the mastermind behind the scenes. Otherwise—" He did not finish, yet that unfinished implication caused the hall's temperature to drop another three degrees.

text.content: Chen Ji prostrated himself in salute, his voice humble: "This disciple obeys." He slowly straightened up, yet in the instant of rising, his gaze inadvertently swept across the gloomy sky outside the hall. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled slightly within his soul, transmitting a vague warning—as if some extremely dangerous existence was approaching.

Just then, violent spiritual energy fluctuations suddenly came from outside the hall. That aura was violent and strange, carrying a nauseating smell of blood that instantly enveloped the entire council hall. The purple-robed emissary frowned, those deep purple eyes flickering with a solemn light: "This aura... interesting."

Chen Ji narrowed his eyes, his heart ringing with alarm. The Tianji Record Fragment trembled frantically, the premonition it transmitted vague and chaotic—countless fragmented images flashed through his soul, all obscured and unclear due to the presence of some key person. He knew, the person he had been searching for all these years... was within that approaching aura.

The hall doors burst open. A blood-red figure stepped across the void. It was a young woman,诡异血色符文 swirling around her, her features bearing three points of resemblance to Chen Ji, yet her eyes were terrifyingly empty. Chen Ji trembled violently. In that moment, the waste persona he had maintained for ten years nearly collapsed—because that woman was precisely his sister who had been missing for many years, Chen Nian.
